what: Removing lint-bash32 from make lint is not behavior-preserving because pre-commit --all-files only enumerates git ls-files, while the existing linter scans tracked plus untracked non-ignored shell files
scenario_or_breakage: Local make lint would silently stop catching Bash 3.2 violations in newly created untracked shell scripts until they are staged or the developer remembers to run make lint-bash32 directly; this is broader than the minimum pre-commit wiring and contradicts the documented untracked-file contract
suggested_fix: Keep lint-bash32 in the lint target, or add an equivalent untracked-aware local gate before dropping it; accepting a small duplicate local run is the minimum-change fix
